source: Class names and order copied from MarsRockDatabase.json (schema mars-rock-db/1) in the team's Unity repo Nasa-Space-App (unchanged from e5a40ad to origin/main ba3c1a5). The Material map's rock positions are in unityRocks.json.

classes.name: Murray formation mudstone (lower Mount Sharp)
classes.summary: Finely laminated lake mudstone that makes up the lower slopes of Mount Sharp.

classes.name: Vera Rubin ridge (hematite-bearing Murray)
classes.summary: Resistant ridge of Murray mudstone, seen from orbit as rich in hematite.

classes.name: Glen Torridon clay-bearing unit (Carolyn Shoemaker fm.)
classes.summary: Clay-rich mudstone and sandstone of the trough south of Vera Rubin ridge.

classes.name: Mirador formation sulfate-bearing unit
classes.summary: Sulfate-rich layers higher on Mount Sharp, from the drying of Gale's lake.

classes.name: Amapari iron-rich bed (Mirador fm.)
classes.summary: Unusually iron-rich layer of the Mirador formation (about 40 wt% FeO by APXS).

classes.name: Stimson formation sandstone (Siccar Point group)
classes.summary: Cross-bedded sandstone from ancient dunes, lying on top of the eroded Murray mudstone.

classes.name: Silica-rich alteration (Buckskin, Stimson halos)
classes.summary: Pale rock strongly enriched in silica by later fluids.

classes.name: Iron-nickel meteorite (found on Mount Sharp)
classes.summary: Dense, magnetic iron-nickel meteorite from a metal-rich asteroid, with a pitted, highly specular surface.
